description: This file contains unit tests for proxy server key management and related operations in the litellm project, including interactions with GitHub, environment variables, and HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its output as a string.

methods.name: test_add_new_key
methods.description: Tests the process of adding a new key via the proxy server, including retries and response validation.

methods.name: test_update_new_key
methods.description: Tests updating a key via the proxy server and verifies the response contains a valid key.

methods.name: test_add_new_key_max_parallel_limit
methods.description: Tests concurrent requests to the proxy server to verify proper handling of max parallel limits.

methods.name: test_add_new_key_max_parallel_limit_streaming
methods.description: Tests concurrent streaming requests to the proxy server to verify handling under load.
